title: iTutorGroup automated age screening
system_purpose: Filter applications for remote tutoring roles
decision_impact: Automatic rejection prevented applicants from advancing
verified_facts: EEOC alleged that configured software automatically rejected women aged 55 or older and men aged 60 or older.
quantitative_evidence: More than 200 qualified applicants were rejected; settlement relief was $365000.
limitations: The official testimony explicitly cautions that the software may have been rule-based automation rather than AI; no technical audit is public.

title: Amazon experimental recruiting model
decision_impact: Model recommendations could influence which candidates received recruiter attention
verified_facts: EEOC-hosted testimony recounts reports that Amazon developed a recruiting tool from 2014 and scrapped it after finding bias against women.
quantitative_evidence: The cited testimony provides dates but no affected-applicant count or deployed-decision rate.
limitations: This was a reported experimental tool rather than a regulator finding of a deployed discriminatory decision system.
